question: Does a seeded size-aware placement entry give artists useful independent control over separation and size, while retained geometry supports motif and proposal substitutions?
decision: Investigate exposing a required separation scale and radius interval; no default or encouraged continuous range is approved.
hypothesis: For one fixed ordered proposal stream, a scale of 1.2 reserves visibly more space between circular motifs than 1.0; reducing the maximum radius from 64 to 32 changes the size structure; motif substitution preserves the accepted geometry.

baseline.kind: independently specified private mechanism prototype, not an upstream baseline
baseline.colour_assignment: original proposal index modulo fixed palette length, also for radial route; surviving proposals keep colours when acceptance changes

variants.change: separation scale 1.0 to 1.2, exact same proposals
maximum radius 64 to 32, same centre proposals and random units
four-segment inscribed diamonds using exact baseline retained geometry and each original proposal-index colour
explicit deterministic radial proposals through the same filter, drawn as rings; transfer test, not an isolated parameter comparison

comparison: Root and Sol inspect every frame. Record normalized RGB MAE and changed-pixel fraction against base for the two parameter variants and diamond transfer, with canvas/background checks. Record exact proposal/centre/accepted geometry digests, counts, RNG draw/state accounting and unchanged retained geometry for motif edits. Do not infer monotonic accepted counts for arbitrary proposal streams.
constraints: Private diagnostics only; no public operation implementation or catalog admission is authorized by this experiment.
Five registered images total, no automatic retries or additional comparison renders.
Serialize rendering under the repository Processing render lock; preserve each terminal attempt.
All images, temporary binaries and detailed geometry stay inside ignored .work paths.
First run pure numeric/ownership/order checks and an independent stream oracle; freeze source hashes before rendering.
Use existing pinned runtime; no changes to CP1/CP2 source, artifacts or accepted reports.
Numeric-only work may include the 200000-proposal source workload; it is not an approved maximum input bound.

retention_criteria.separation: Retain for contract investigation only if source-bound geometry proves the intended threshold, exact proposal reuse isolates the edit, and direct inspection finds an understandable spacing change. A pixel difference alone is insufficient.
retention_criteria.radius: Retain radius endpoints as explicit proposal geometry if the size edit visibly changes composition and its proposal mapping is documented. These two maximum values do not establish a continuous recommended range.
retention_criteria.composition: Retain the two-level design only if the same acceptance kernel serves the seeded and authored-radial routes and the same retained geometry supports both motifs without collision logic in caller drawing code.
retention_criteria.failure: If numerical checks, work cost or visuals fail, preserve the result and revise the boundary/configuration before any additional experiment. Do not reclassify a failed attempt or weaken its acceptance.

proposal_semantics.mode: private portable design, not Processing compatibility
proposal_semantics.seed_domain: uint32, tested seed42; no public RNG API
proposal_semantics.initialization: Zero-extend seed to uint64 SplitMix64 state. Take two successive outputs q0,q1; pack [low32(q0),high32(q0),low32(q1),high32(q1)]. Standard SplitMix64 constants/transition from the cited author specification. All-zero xoshiro state is unreachable and asserted as an internal invariant.
proposal_semantics.unit: uint32 output divided by 2^32, exact binary64 [0,1)
proposal_semantics.consumption: Four unconditional units per attempt: ux,uy,u,v; rejected proposals consume all four; no style draws share this stream.
proposal_semantics.centre_order: px=512*ux; x=64+px; py=512*uy; y=64+py; each operation separately rounded to binary64. These fixed-profile centres lie in [64,576).
proposal_semantics.radius_order: span=maxRadius-4; first=span*u; second=first*v; r=4+second, each separately rounded binary64. The fixed wide profile normally excludes maxRadius; a future general interval cannot promise exclusive geometric endpoints because final additions may round to them.
proposal_semantics.acceptance_order: Visit accepted circles in proposal order. dx=x-oldX; dy=y-oldY; xx=dx*dx; yy=dy*dy; distanceSquared=xx+yy; sumR=r+oldR; threshold=sumR*separationScale; thresholdSquared=threshold*threshold. All separately rounded binary64; reject if distanceSquared<thresholdSquared, accepting equality. Reject nonfinite intermediates as a failed private experiment. This specified squared predicate is not a bit-identity claim about Processing float dist().
proposal_semantics.storage: Append accepted centre/radius/original-index geometry only; seeded path does not retain rejected proposals. Motif variant reuses baseline retained geometry.

authored_radial.source_relation: Authored transfer from a radial arrangement, not studio random proposals or source reproduction.

limits: The two separation frames investigate scale1 and1.2 only. Source0.96 overlap is not visually approved or recommended by this experiment.
The maximum-radius settings32 and64 are isolated measured prototype configurations, not a recommended continuous range.
Authored radial layout and diamonds are design transfer checks, not additional sampled corpus techniques.
